method: Staged extension loaded unpacked in headless Microsoft Edge with a throwaway profile; each tuple sets the stored preferences, reloads the page and checks page overflow, visible elements leaving the viewport and clipped text.

dimensions.surfaces: nine options tabs and the popup
dimensions.viewports: normal 1280x900 physical window (CSS width divided by scale) and minimum 360x640 CSS

limits: Headless emulation, not an installed copy or a physical display. The check finds overflow and clipping; it does not judge visual quality, so representative captures were also inspected.
